newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: C&W Manila unit says in deal with Alcatel.
newsitem.headline: C&W Manila unit says in deal with Alcatel.

text.p: Eastern Telecommunications Philippines Inc (ETPI), a unit of Cable & Wireless plc, said on Wednesday it had signed a 8.8 billion peso deal with Alcatel Alsthom for the supply and installation of 300,000 telephone lines.
ETPI president Melquiades Gutiariez told reporters the turnkey contract agreement was signed earlier on Wednesday.
Alcatel will collaborate with ETPI's wholly-owned subsidiary Telecommunications Technologies Philippines Inc in installing the lines, Gutiariez said.
ETPI is required to put up 300,000 telephone lines in exchange for a permit to operate an international gateway facility.
